notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market ecommerce analytics SaaS (product recommendations, catalog search, cart recovery insights).
- Primary interest: move from Hosted API POC -> Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolation.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2024-11-22: inbound trial sign-up; initial discovery with AE (Ethan).
- 2024-12-05: demo focused on embeddings + semantic search (Marisol ran product/tech deep-dive).
- 2024-12-15: POC kickoff (hosted) - ingest pipeline + nightly batch embed job defined.
- 2025-01-10: POC results presented: nightly batch of ~2M SKUs, sample queries 150 qps sustained, avg top-k NN tail latency ~85ms (hosted).
- 2025-01-16: pricing discussion; draft committed for Dedicated sizing options.

Use-case & technical requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: product catalog embeddings, semantic product search, "similar items" rerank, cart-recovery matching, daily re-embed pipeline.
- Throughput targets: baseline 100-200 qps query capacity; spikes to 400 qps during promotions.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 120ms, p99 ideally < 200ms; checkout experience strict: "no >150ms tail" (quote from CTO).
- Indexing: nightly batch job (2M rows), incremental micro-batches during day.
- Vector DB: prefer pgvector (Postgres) for metadata join + Redis caching for hot items; also trialing Weaviate internally.
- Model prefs: 768/1024 dim embeddings; open-model compatible, quantized model option desirable.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit for predictable ARR if unit economics clear.
- Observability desired: token/cost breakdown per route, route-level tail latency, tracing for slow queries.

POC notes & findings:
- Redwood hosted POC matched our throughput targets with recommended batching; saw ~20% cost improvement vs our initial OpenAI run when using batching + prefix caching.
- Team liked fallback routing idea for degraded capacity (auto-fallback to smaller model).
- Integration work: connector built to Postgres + pgvector; TTL cache in Redis for hot SKUs.
- Need dedicated SSD-backed index for nightly rebuilds; ask Redwood about snapshot/restore cadence.

Security/compliance status:
- Completed high-level questionnaire; security team requested SOC2 report and data residency attestations.
- Okta SAML test account pending attribute mapping confirmation.
